correctness.rationale: Whitening converts exact line minimization into rank-one orthogonal projection. Uniform-angle moments give the independent two-step diagonal matrix. A rational partial-fraction integral and an elementary elliptic-angle integral give the paired diagonal matrix, an exact scalar multiple for all r>1; isotropy r=1 is handled separately. Symbolic identities and 50-digit independent angular quadrature reproduce the formulas. No empirical test is promoted to an infinite proof.

limitations: Exact sequential minimization on a fixed SPD quadratic
Uniform spherical marginals, paired via a Haar orthonormal frame in one scheme
No higher dimensional, nonquadratic, stochastic dominance, or multi-epoch assertion

value.rationale: This quantifies a concrete choice in two-query random-direction minimization: independently sampled directions versus an orthogonal Haar pair. The identity is sharp for every initial error, exposes the exact conditioning dependence, and proves a complete two-step solve when curvature is isotropic. It is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a one-step identity repackaged as two steps.
